camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainDetailDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --Field 'bps,ipv6_traf,traf,http_code,qps' --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2020-07-05T22:05:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn hangzhou --StartTime '2020-07-05T22:00:00Z' --Layer all
description_en: Retrieves detailed data for an accelerated domain name by protocol type
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainDetailDataByLayer按协议类型获取加速域名的数据明细（域名维度）
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-detail-data-by-layer --field bps,ipv6_traf,traf,http_code,qps --domain-name example.com --start-time 2020-07-05T22:00:00Z --end-time 2020-07-05T22:05:00Z --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en hangzhou --layer all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainDetailDataByLayer

parameters.help_en: The metrics to query. You can query multiple metrics at a time. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Valid values: bps, qps, traf, acc, ipv6_traf, ipv6_bps, ipv6_acc, ipv6_qps, and http_code
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的指标。支持多指标查询，多个指标用英文逗号（,）分隔，包含bps、qps、traf、acc、ipv6_traf、ipv6_bps、ipv6_acc、ipv6_qps、http_code
parameters.name: field

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name to query. You can query multiple domain names in a single request. To do so, separate the domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持30个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed 1 hour
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间，且间隔不超过1小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query carrier names.

If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is returned
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

不传值代表所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query region names.

If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh:
区域英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

不传值代表所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The dimension to query. Valid values are http, https, and quic for the application layer, or all.

The default value is all
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度，应用层（http、https、quic）或all。

默认为all
parameters.name: layer

DataModule.description_en: The data returned for the accelerated domain name
DataModule.description_zh: 查询的加速域名返回数据

HttpCode.description_en: The distribution of HTTP status codes

Qps.description_en: The number of queries per second (QPS)

TimeStamp.description_en: The start of the time slice
